display_name: CME Globex regular futures session (Eastern Time)
description: Authoritative generic exchange/session facts. Strategy and market-context windows (Asia, London, NY pre-market, overnight, OR) do not belong here.
trading_date_convention: A session is identified by its trading_date and spans [18:00 ET on the prior calendar day, 17:00 ET on the trading date). An instant at or after 18:00 ET belongs to the next calendar date; an instant before 17:00 ET belongs to its own calendar date. Instants in [17:00, 18:00) ET are the maintenance break and belong to no session. A resulting date that is not a trading weekday belongs to no session.

timestamp_convention.timezone_handling: Timezone-aware timestamps only; wall-clock rules are evaluated in the session timezone (DST-aware, never a fixed UTC offset).
timestamp_convention.bar_labels: For bar-labelled data, rules are evaluated on the bar-start instant (bar_end label minus bar interval) and the whole bar must end no later than the session close. The canonical MNQ 1-minute dataset uses NinjaTrader bar_end labels.

calendar.missing_vs_closure_rule: The previous/next expected session is derived from the regular weekly schedule plus explicit overrides. A date is calendar_verified only inside the declared override coverage (or when it has an explicit override); outside coverage an absent session cannot be classified as a legitimate exchange closure.
